WITH
-- Filter customers by segment and currency CZK
customers_czk AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment
    FROM customers
    WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
),
-- Sum consumption per customer for 2013
consumption_2013 AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers_czk c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE substr(ym.Date,1,4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
),
-- Find minimum consumption per segment
min_consumption_per_segment AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, MIN(co.total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM consumption_2013 co
    JOIN customers_czk c ON co.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
-- Customers with minimum consumption per segment
min_consumers AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, co.CustomerID, co.total_consumption
    FROM consumption_2013 co
    JOIN customers_czk c ON co.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN min_consumption_per_segment m ON c.Segment = m.Segment AND co.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
),
-- Calculate annual average consumption of customers with lowest consumption per segment
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM min_consumers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME

WITH
-- Filter transactions paid in CZK in 2013 and sum consumption per customer
CustomerConsumption AS (
    SELECT
        t.CustomerID,
        SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND substr(t.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID
),
-- Get the minimum consumption per segment
MinConsumptionPerSegment AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        MIN(cc.TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM CustomerConsumption cc
    JOIN customers c ON cc.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
-- Get customers with minimum consumption per segment
MinCustomers AS (
    SELECT
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        cc.TotalConsumption
    FROM CustomerConsumption cc
    JOIN customers c ON cc.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN MinConsumptionPerSegment mcs ON c.Segment = mcs.Segment AND cc.TotalConsumption = mcs.MinConsumption
),
-- Calculate annual average consumption of customers with minimum consumption per segment
AnnualAvgMinConsumption AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        AVG(TotalConsumption) AS AvgMinConsumption
    FROM MinCustomers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AvgMinConsumption FROM AnnualAvgMinConsumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT AvgMinConsumption FROM AnnualAvgMinConsumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    
    (SELECT AvgMinConsumption FROM AnnualAvgMinConsumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT AvgMinConsumption FROM AnnualAvgMinConsumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    
    (SELECT AvgMinConsumption FROM AnnualAvgMinConsumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT AvgMinConsumption FROM AnnualAvgMinConsumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME

WITH
-- Filter customers by segment and currency CZK
customers_czk AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment
    FROM customers
    WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
),
-- Sum consumption per customer for 2013
consumption_2013 AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    WHERE substr(ym.Date,1,4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
),
-- Join consumption with customers filtered by CZK currency
consumption_czk AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, co.total_consumption
    FROM customers_czk c
    JOIN consumption_2013 co ON c.CustomerID = co.CustomerID
),
-- Find minimum consumption per segment
min_consumption_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM consumption_czk
    GROUP BY Segment
),
-- Customers with minimum consumption per segment
min_consumers AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, c.total_consumption
    FROM consumption_czk c
    JOIN min_consumption_per_segment m
      ON c.Segment = m.Segment AND c.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
),
-- Count of min consumers per segment
min_consumers_count AS (
    SELECT Segment, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM min_consumers
    GROUP BY Segment
),
-- Sum of min consumption per segment (should be min_consumption * count)
sum_min_consumption_per_segment AS (
    SELECT m.Segment, m.min_consumption * mc.cnt AS total_min_consumption, mc.cnt
    FROM min_consumption_per_segment m
    JOIN min_consumers_count mc ON m.Segment = mc.Segment
),
-- Calculate annual average consumption of customers with lowest consumption per segment
annual_avg_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, total_min_consumption / cnt AS annual_avg
    FROM sum_min_consumption_per_segment
),
-- Select annual averages for SME, LAM, KAM
avg_SME AS (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME'),
avg_LAM AS (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM'),
avg_KAM AS (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM')

SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_SME) - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_LAM) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_LAM) - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_KAM) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_KAM) - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_SME) AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH 
-- Filter customers by segment and currency CZK
customers_czk AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment
    FROM customers
    WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
),
-- Sum consumption per customer for 2013
consumption_2013 AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    WHERE substr(ym.Date,1,4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
),
-- Join consumption with customers to get segment and filter CZK customers only
consumption_segment AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, co.total_consumption
    FROM customers_czk c
    JOIN consumption_2013 co ON c.CustomerID = co.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
),
-- Find minimum consumption per segment
min_consumption_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM consumption_segment
    GROUP BY Segment
),
-- Find customers with minimum consumption per segment
min_consumers AS (
    SELECT cs.Segment, cs.CustomerID, cs.total_consumption
    FROM consumption_segment cs
    JOIN min_consumption_per_segment mcs 
      ON cs.Segment = mcs.Segment AND cs.total_consumption = mcs.min_consumption
),
-- Calculate annual average consumption of customers with minimum consumption per segment
annual_avg_min_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM min_consumers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') - 
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - 
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - 
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH 
-- Filter transactions in 2013 paid in CZK and join with customers to get segments
trans_2013_czk AS (
    SELECT 
        t.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        t.Amount * t.Price AS TotalPrice
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE t.Date BETWEEN '20130101' AND '20131231'
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
),
-- Sum total consumption per customer in 2013 paid in CZK
customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        SUM(TotalPrice) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM trans_2013_czk
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
-- Find minimum consumption per segment
min_consumption_per_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM customer_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
